supporting_observations.claim: The alerted outbound activity is associated with C:\Program Files\GradeBookPro\gradebookproupd.exe running as raul.diaz on WS-RDIAZ-01.

That process connected through the proxy to update.gradebookpro.com at approximately five-minute intervals: 13:37:44, 13:42:39, 13:47:35, 13:51:57, 13:56:59, 14:02:21, and 14:07:25 UTC. The 13:47:35 attempt was denied (403) and the 14:07:25 attempt returned a gateway error (504); the other listed proxy attempts returned status 200.

The observed destination and cadence are consistent with the provided inventory, which identifies this updater as approved and says it checks update.gradebookpro.com about every five minutes. The evidence supports treating the alerted activity as benign rather than as the scheduled svc-grades/GradeSync password-rotation work.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show the destination and tunnel outcomes, but do not establish the contents of the encrypted HTTPS traffic or whether an update was downloaded or applied.
The available periodic updater records cover 13:37:44 through 14:07:25 UTC; they do not show the start or end of the alert's full stated interval.
The supplied process and network records do not independently establish the updater binary's hash or signature.
claims_not_established: Whether the updater received or applied any update, or what content the HTTPS sessions carried.
Whether there were additional updater connections outside the listed records during the full alert interval.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: tess.hart launched Remote Desktop toward WS-RDIAZ-01 using raul.diaz credentials; a subsequent network logon to WS-RDIAZ-01 came from 10.56.10.24. This is inconsistent with the stated remote-administration practice and is not the alerted HTTPS activity. Records: T286-00131, T286-00133, T286-00197.
Separate review: WS-ACOLE-01 accessed WS-RDIAZ-01 over SMB, and records show network logons to WS-RDIAZ-01 for raul.diaz from WS-ACOLE-01. Records: T286-00273, T286-00217, T286-00279.

Separate review: FILE-ORC-01 initiated connections to WS-RDIAZ-01, including an RDP connection, which merits validation against authorized activity. Records: T286-00381, T286-00384, T286-00388, T286-00390, T286-00391, T286-00393.

Separate review: Dropbox was launched on WS-RDIAZ-01; the inventory says no other cloud-storage services beyond approved services are authorized. This is separate from the GradeBook updater connections. Records: T286-00474, T286-00475, T286-00476.
Separate review: browser traffic to Slack and Zoom is visible on WS-RDIAZ-01; neither service is listed among the approved services. Records: T286-00030, T286-00033, T286-00494, T286-00495.
